question: On the electrical plan, are the transformer pads located on the private property side of the property boundary lines? Are they entirely within the project limits and not in the right-of-way or straddling property lines?
checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking whether transformer pads are positioned relative to property boundary lines and right-of-way edges—this requires spatial measurement/clearance verification (distance from boundary, containment within limits) rather than simple presence detection.
